text: Awakening Caretakers are earthen located in the Awakening Machine in the Hall of Awakening.
Awakening Technicians are earthen located in the Awakening Machine in the Hall of Awakening.
Awakened Tabard is a quest reward from Whoever You Want to Be.
Awakened Mechanical Cache is a quest reward from Gearing Up for Trouble, the weekly wrapper quest for the Awakening The Machine event in Gundargaz of the Ringing Deeps.
Awakened Cog is rewarded by completing waves in the Awakening The Machine event. They need to be obtained for Speaker Kuldas in Fire and Gemstone.

Awakening The Machine is a weekly task in Gundargaz of the Ringing Deeps, tasking players with clearing twenty waves while keeping Speaker Kuldas alive, with checkpoints every five. Each checkpoint cleared will unlock an additional Awakened Cache, each containing greater rewards.
Awakened Archivists are earthen Archivists located in the Sacred Hollow and at Ghoststone Diggings on the Siren Isle.

__NOTOC__ The Awoken Coelacanth is a fish from . Anglers seeking this elusive fish can only do so by utilizing Whispering Stargazers; throwing one of them into the waters of Azj-Kahet provides a ten percent chance to catch a coelacanth on a given cast, with the buff increasing to one hundred percent with the use of additional Stargazers. Upon either catching a coelacanth or moving in any way, the buff disappears.
Axxi Cutflare is a goblin located in a building in the Vatworks in Undermine.
Azerite-Carved Ritual Kris can be purchased from Churbro in Boralus and Zuldazar for .
Awakened Defense Matrices are titan orbs located in Overcharged Delves.
The Axxarien Crystal is found at Axxarien on Bloodmyst Isle. The Crystal Mining Pick can be used here in order to obtain a Axxarien Crystal Sample during The Final Sample.
Awakened Defensive Constructs are located in Overcharged Delves.
Awakening The Machine: Wave 10 is an exploration achievement earned by reaching wave 10 of the Awakening The Machine.
Awakening The Machine: Wave 20 is an exploration achievement earned by reaching wave 20 of the Awakening The Machine.
Awakening The Machine: Wave 30 is an exploration achievement earned by reaching wave 30 of the Awakening The Machine. It rewarded the Machine-Warden's Tabard.
Awakening The Machine: Wave 40 is an exploration achievement earned by reaching wave 40 of the Awakening The Machine. It rewarded the Machine-Warden's Pauldrons.
Awakening The Machine: Wave 50 is an exploration achievement earned by reaching wave 50 of the Awakening The Machine. It rewarded the Machine-Warden's Cloak and the title.
Awakened Supply Crate is sold by Hooded Purveyor on Siren Isle for .

The Azerothian Archives and its members have set out to uncover old mysteries across the areas of the Dragon Isles. Their temporary offices are located in a tower at Algeth'ar Academy in northern Thaldraszus and can also be found at Traitor's Rest in the Azure Span where their operations are led by Eadweard Dalyngrigge.

The Azeroth Commerce Authority have supply officers around the various capitals of Azeroth. Originally commissioned to facilitate trade across the Eastern Kingdoms, the ACA now maintains supply routes to Alliance forces worldwide. The Horde version of this faction is Durotar Supply and Logistics.
Azshara Snakehead is an objective of Pond Predators. They are fished from the pond in Thunder Bluff during the daily quest.
Azure Foals are vorquin located in the Ruins of Karnthar in the Azure Span.
Azure Herdmares are vorquin located in the Ruins of Karnthar in the Azure Span.
Azora Apprentice Notes are gained by casting Polymorph on Polymorphed Apprentices in to turn them back into Servants of Azora. Combining 6 of them will create Spell Notes: Enlightenment.

Azeroth Interiors is an interior‑design competition for World of Warcraft introduced on 27 January 2026. The event showcases the new housing system added with the Midnight expansion and features six pairs of prominent community creators competing to design the best in‑game home. Each team consists of a "Homeowner" and a "Builder", who collaborate across three phases. In Phase One, teams gather inspiration using personal Pinterest boards. Phase Two focuses on constructing their designs in‑game. Phase Three concludes with a live walkthrough and judging stream to determine the winning home. The winning build will be featured as a custom listing on the real‑estate website , via a promotional web
